# Language, Interaction, & Cognition Lab

<p class="home-subtitle">Department of Cognitive & Information Sciences</p>
:::

:::

::: {.home-content-grid}

::: {.home-about}
How do we decode another person's thoughts and intentions from a sequence of
sounds (speech) or shapes (letters, signs)? And how do we choose what to say
next to transfer our thoughts to another person's mind? The LInC Lab is a group of
cognitive scientists tackling these questions using behavioral,
neuroscientific, and computational tools.

To get more information about ongoing projects, please visit the
[research](research.qmd) page or check individual [lab members'](people.qmd)
pages for a full list of their publications. If you would like to participate
in the lab's research or are interested in joining the lab, please [get in
touch](contact.qmd).

:::
